description: This Java source file defines a Spring Boot configuration class for the Eclipse Hono COAP adapter. It includes bean definitions, configuration properties, and customization methods related to setting up and managing the COAP adapter and its metrics.

classes.name: Config
classes.description: Spring Boot configuration class for setting up the COAP adapter, defining beans, customization methods, and configuration properties.

methods.name: vertxBasedCoapAdapter
methods.description: Defines a prototype-scoped bean for VertxBasedCoapAdapter instances.

methods.name: customizeDownstreamSenderFactoryConfig
methods.description: Customizes the configuration for downstream sender factory if the name is not set.

methods.name: customizeRegistrationClientFactoryConfig
methods.description: Customizes the registration client factory configuration if the name is not set.

methods.name: customizeCredentialsClientFactoryConfig
methods.description: Customizes the credentials client factory configuration if the name is not set.

methods.name: customizeTenantClientFactoryConfig
methods.description: Customizes the tenant client factory configuration if the name is not set.

methods.name: adapterProperties
methods.description: Exposes COAP adapter's configuration properties as a Spring bean with prefix 'hono.coap'.

methods.name: commonTags
methods.description: Creates a MeterRegistryCustomizer to add common tags for metrics reporting.

methods.name: serviceFactory
methods.description: Provides a factory bean for creating instances of the VertxBasedCoapAdapter.
